structural_change: s81sl_lepmuh_c12f successor (c12f daemon NEEDS_RTL TT -235.5: 548 paths RX SRAM rd_out -> N-face ml_wd capture, 278 ps macro access + 140 ps forwarding + 530 ps wire; ~250 vq fan-out paths). OT_S81SL_LEP_RXLAND: RX head = LANDING REGISTER beside the RX macros; the macro reads one row ahead (read-pointer copies reset to 1, same advance) and the landing register loads wd on a same-edge write to rp_nx, else mem[rp+1] on pop, else holds -> same head value every non-empty cycle, same edges, 0 added cycles, no port/protocol/latency change. li_v landing flop vq replicated into kept per-consumer copies (SRAM write-hit / rx_control / host enables), kept wp and pair-advance copies (each select <=32 loads). Floorplan: RX macros moved from the E column to two rows under the N face (lane 0 top row, lane 1 below), x 43.2..397, between the W landing flops and the N ml_wd capture; the empty N band is now the RX region. Outline unchanged.
